split.method: StratifiedGroupKFold (stratified by material_class; groups = connected components of (same sample_id) OR (emissivity RMSE < 0.005); random_state = 42)

atmospheres.downwelling_definition: hemispheric F_down/pi, 8-pt Gauss-Legendre in mu; L_down = F_down/pi (hemispheric sky radiance for a Lambertian surface), W/(m^2 sr um), no extra /pi applies. Source: src/data_generation/base/automate_modtran.py (hemispheric_downwelling).

canonical_counts_fold0.plain_language: Each evaluation partition = targets x atmospheres x temperatures; every sample also carries sensor noise (NEDT = ASTER 0.3 K, HYTES 0.2 K at evaluation; x U(0.5, 1.5) in training) and an atmospheric-correction PWV error (N4: 2.97 mm at evaluation, U(1.84, 4.1) mm in training). Fold 0 totals 14,084 samples per sensor (28,168 for ASTER + HyTES).

train.emissivity_augmentation: none: training emissivity = pristine laboratory spectrum (N5 + N6, v1.2.2)
